Hand colored. Relief shown pictorially. Depths shown by soundings. Shows Maritime Provinces, New England, and St. Lawrence Valley region to Montreal. Includes table of sources of observations. Scale ca. 1:1,900,000; English marine leagues 20 to a degree; English miles 69 1/2 to a degree. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.
